query: The checkout-flow.spec.ts E2E shard reds about one run in five and then goes green on a plain re-run with nobody touching the code. Can you actually find out why instead of us all just hitting retry?
note: Fails-then-passes-on-retry with no code change is the literal definition of a flake in this skill — user needs the MINE → REPRODUCE → ROOT-CAUSE loop without ever naming it.

query: deflake the dashboard-widgets spec please, it's killing us
note: Informal, but 'deflake this spec' is called out verbatim in the skill description as a trigger phrase.

query: Start the ci-flake-hunter lane against the integration branch and keep it running until the queue stops ejecting people.
note: Names the lane/agent directly; ci-flake-hunter is the agent that runs this skill's protocol.

query: PR #1184 got booted out of the merge queue again. Third time this week, and each time the build that reds is a speculative one — my own PR checks were all green on the exact same SHA. What is going on and how do we stop it?
note: Same SHA green at the PR gate but red in merge_group is the queue-killer flake signature the skill's Step 1(c) tells you to hunt worst-first.

query: Job 'e2e (shard 3/6)' failed with: npm ERR! network request to https://registry.example-mirror.dev/@scope%2fui failed, reason: read ECONNRESET. Do I need to fix something in our build config or is this just noise?
note: Package-mirror/CDN fetch failure — Step 0 transient-INFRA classification. The correct answer (re-run, open NO code PR) is exactly what this skill encodes; 'fixing' the build config is the named anti-pattern.

query: Nine jobs across four different PRs all went red in the last twenty minutes with 'JWTExpired: exp claim timestamp check failed'. None of these PRs touch auth. Are we all broken or is something environmental?
note: Shared test token aging out mid-suite across many jobs at once — a Step 0 transient-infra signature class that must NOT be code-fixed.

query: Every outbound call in the integration suite is coming back 429 from the fixtures host now. Should I be adding backoff to the test client?
note: Blanket rate-limit/WAF on one host is transient INFRA per Step 0; the skill is what stops you from 'fixing' it in code.

query: is this a flake or is it real? the a11y scan on the reports page fails maybe a third of the time with a color-contrast violation on an element that definitely has the right contrast
note: 'Is this a flake or real' is a named trigger, and an a11y scan running before the container settles is one of the skill's catalogued race mechanisms (settle race).

query: Our merge queue throughput has collapsed. Correct PRs keep getting ejected, their auto-merge silently disarms, and then they just sit there green and unqueued forever. I think one bad shard is taxing everything behind it.
note: This is the exact economic argument in the skill body (a live flake taxes every PR behind it) plus the Step 7 unstick-the-strays work. User never says 'flake'.

query: I ran the settings spec 40 times locally with --repeat-each and it passed every single time, but CI reds on it constantly. What am I doing wrong?
note: Step 2 verbatim: if it passes 20x clean locally you have NOT reproduced it — reproduce harsher than CI (prod build, worker count, CPU throttle) until it fails on demand.

query: The e2e matrix is fully green but it takes 43 minutes to finish and it's the long pole on every single PR. Can we get that down?
note: Near-miss: same CI + same E2E matrix, but the job is GREEN and the complaint is wall-clock latency. Flake-hunting explicitly never touches timing; speed owns slow-but-green.

query: Our node_modules cache key includes the git SHA so it misses on literally every run, and the browser-install step re-downloads 400MB each time. Fix the caching and re-shard the matrix from 4 to 8 while you're in there.
note: Near-miss: cold cache + re-sharding are the speed skill's bottleneck classes. Sharding and caching are named as things flake-hunting must NEVER touch.

query: Merge queue takes about an hour to drain because the lint job blocks the build job blocks the e2e job in a serial needs-chain, and we rebuild the app three separate times. Nothing is failing — it's just slow.
note: Near-miss: shares 'merge queue' and 'CI' heavily, but explicitly nothing is red. Serial needs-chain + redundant rebuild are speed diagnoses.

query: CI on my branch is red — typecheck fails with TS2345 on src/api/orders.ts:88, and it's failed identically on all four runs today. It's clearly from my own diff. Fix it and get the PR mergeable.
note: Near-miss: red CI, but deterministic (4/4 identical failures) and traceable to the author's own diff. The skill's own bar says a hard wall is a REAL regression, not a flake — this is the checks lane's work.

query: PR #902 reds the merge_group every single time it's speculated and takes the whole ALLGREEN batch down with it. It's a poison pill. Dequeue it, draft it, and re-arm the innocent PRs it dropped.
note: Near-miss: merge-queue ejections and re-arming are shared vocabulary, but a consistently-red poison pill is not intermittent. pr-checks owns dequeue/draft/re-arm; flake-hunting only hunts intermittent reds.

query: PR #77 has been green for six hours, mergeStateStatus says BLOCKED, and the auto-merge I armed yesterday is just... gone. Nothing is failing. Why won't it merge?
note: Near-miss: 'auto-merge dropped' and queue mechanics overlap, but there is no red and no intermittency at all — this is mergeStateStatus interpretation, which lives in driving-prs-to-merge.

query: The review bot left eleven unresolved threads across three PRs, a couple of which I think are just wrong. Push fixes for the good ones, push back on the bad ones, resolve the threads, then arm auto-merge.
note: Near-miss: shares the watcher-lane framing and the arm-auto-merge step, but the subject is review threads, not a red or intermittent job.

query: We've got about a dozen merged PRs whose branches and worktrees are still lying around, and their linked issues never auto-closed because we merge into an integration branch. Tidy all that up.
note: Near-miss: same fleet-of-lanes context and same integration-branch detail, but this is post-merge janitorial work on CLOSED PRs — no CI signal involved.

query: Users are reporting that the invoice list intermittently shows zero rows on first load, then fills in if you refresh. Nothing is red in CI. Can you drive the signed-in app in a real browser and catch the failing request?
note: Near-miss and a genuinely tricky one: it IS an intermittent race and even sounds like a hydration bug, but it's a production symptom with no CI red — live-browser repro, not CI-history mining.

query: We already root-caused the mock-order race in the notifications spec but nobody has bandwidth this sprint. Write it up as a proper groomed ticket with the evidence and acceptance criteria so an agent can pick it up cold.
note: Near-miss: the subject IS a flake, but the ask is to produce a groomed issue, not to hunt or fix. Filing format and acceptance criteria belong to gh-issue-filing.
